page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at left; one block of running text; catchword at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: impossibile nobis fit, non in multiplici in-gratitudinis reatu implicari atque involvi: quo (nisi Judicii sui rigorem Deus, pro Pa-terna sua miseratione, propter Christi Me-rita, remittat atque dissolvat) actum esse de nobis merito suspicemur. Quæ unica con-fideratio omnem propriè nostra condignita-tis, ex æqualitate justitiæ apud Deum, arrogantiam Papisticam conterat prorsus atque pessundet.

page.notes: Large ink blot in the middle of the page, over the blank lower half; it covers any text that may have been there. Faint, greyed lines in the lower half and along the left and right edges are show-through from the other side of the leaf and are not transcribed. The faint line near the foot ("C c 2"-like mark) is too faint to read with confidence and was left out as possible show-through. The catchword "CAP" at lower right is partly cut off; the final character is uncertain.
